status: prospective; no experiment fits or native jobs yet
question: Can a fixed targeted coverage intervention repair the three new cap128 false acceptances and shared-AND false rejection while preserving all prior required accuracy and budget gains?

supported_observations: opt_merge identifies cells with identical inputs and shares the instance.
opt_share considers mutually exclusive same-type cells sharing an input and driving the same multiplexer.
These are motivations for joint dependency/sharing coverage; they do not establish which pass caused the observed four circuit costs.

empirical_motivation.interpretation: The observed sparse coverage motivates the intervention. Counts depend on explicitly defined input-only structural profiles and do not prove causation.

controlled_intervention.features: Frozen233 columns; no new feature engineering.
controlled_intervention.learner: Same native multioutput ExtraTreesClassifier parameters, fixed seed, equal weights,300trees,1thread.
controlled_intervention.policy: Same fixed probability>=0.5 including ties, same scope and signed/release bounds; no confidence-threshold search.
controlled_intervention.baseline: Reuse the frozen1889-row233 classifier without refitting.
controlled_intervention.new_fit: One new fit on exact original1889 rows plus32 genuinely new training circuits.
controlled_intervention.interpretation: This tests the entire fixed coverage intervention, not separate attribution to its two training subgroups. Differences in predictions arise from retraining with the added rows; no claim of a new architecture.

validation_requirements: Freeze original circuits and structural/modular novelty screens before measurements; preserve every historical labelled and unlabelled input.
Audit input-only coverage profiles against the four consumed failures before labels; matching profiles do not guarantee matching area.
Keep consumed evaluation labels out of fitting. Freeze weights, every fresh prediction and finite selection before fresh labels.
Preserve all existing six accuracy/tail comparators and cap gates; preserve the latest classifier gains on its passing general/legacy populations.

Do not require agreement with unsafe prior classifier decisions or silently introduce mathematically impossible accuracy gates on failed subsets. All added requirements receive a prospective feasibility audit.
Retain independent full general, sharing, legacy, conditional and active evaluations with separate false-acceptance/rejection counts and denominators.
limitations: The new training and test structures must change behavior meaningfully; redundant arithmetic wrappers do not establish structural-family novelty.
Probabilities are uncalibrated. No arbitrary post-label margin, rule change or subgroup exclusion is allowed.
The unchanged bounds cannot fix every inherited budget error. Completion still requires every frozen goal gate; no universal safety or CPU-performance claim.
